authoring_rule.computed_duration: 30-day authored work + ACTINV cooling duration; q* is calibrated on this design at 30 days of cooldown for the first fixed-history replacement
authoring_rule.fixed_duration: 60 days (authored from FARIS archived fixed-history event durations)
authoring_rule.zero_unplanned: The operating-history schema has no unplanned outage/reliability model; only planned replacements are present.

external_inputs.audit: Coordinator supplies the current read-only material/data audit compatible with physics.json.
external_inputs.cross_sections: Coordinator supplies a cross_sections.xml matching the physics data identity.

matched_case.provenance: Authored code-verification schedule: two archived blanket operating intervals of 79,859,518.2721506 s with one 60-day replacement between them. The horizon ends 600 s before the next threshold trigger so it contains one completed blanket outage and no terminal event. The flux limit remains native blanket flux rate × the authored interval; it is not a measured or qualified material lifetime.
matched_case.terminal_trigger_margin_rule: Stop one 600-second FARIS history step before the second integrated-flux trigger so only the single completed inter-campaign replacement is in this controlled horizon.

native_path: faris reactor run --activation-spectra fispact-709 produces a revalidated run.json and 709-group transport-spectra.json from the exact case scenario and physics files.
faris history from-run writes native TransportDrivingRates; the runner derives the authored integrated-flux threshold from its blanket rate multiplied by the 79,859,518.2721506 s operating interval.

faris maintenance run evaluates fixed and ACTINV-coupled histories under the same scenario, transport record, one-boundary-outage horizon, service limit, and energy inputs. Only maintenance-duration coupling differs.

outputs.energy: The FARIS result lifetime_net_electricity_mwh is retained as native output; shared 500 MW(e) peer normalization is separate and must not overwrite it.
outputs.fixed_and_computed: FARIS native faris-maintenance-result/v0.1 JSON and faris maintenance report.

scope: Authored cold-data, two-campaign, one-boundary-outage maintenance code-verification case. FARIS runs native histories; fixed and ACTINV-coupled branches share the same inputs. Materials and source are cold-data numerical surrogates and not experimentally validated.
